Trust decision: `coderd/aibridgedserver.IsAuthorized` (aibridgedserver.go:619-632) gates the AI Bridge LLM proxy on key existence/expiry/secret + non-deleted/non-system owner, but never on `user.Status == active`, so suspended/dormant owners kept access.

pattern_fit: `injection_only` — the published fix is one added predicate in one function; no O2 second implementation and no O8 uncovered route (HTTP route, in-process delegated transport and aibridgeproxyd all funnel through the same IsAuthorized; `/api/v2/aibridge/proxy` already uses `httpmw.ExtractAPIKey`, which checks status at apikey.go:685).

Strongest lever: the input-shape variant — the advisory says "suspended", so a solver naturally writes `Status == UserStatusSuspended` and misses dormant accounts; next best is the dormant-reactivation coupled behaviour (httpmw/apikey.go:668-689).

Biggest red flag: `single_site` — a 3-line, one-location fix a careful engineer finds in ~10 minutes, so this host likely won't make tasks both target models fail.
